note: S74 epoch-chain commitment: binds sequence, explicitly does NOT bind state (that is S73 fold-forward). 32 B per epoch.

controls.name: C_honest_chain_verifies
controls.must_fire_because: the honest chain does not reproduce its own heads -- then every rejection below is vacuous

controls.name: C_regrouping_detected
controls.must_fire_because: two epoch groupings of one atom set share a chain head -- the chain would add nothing to the root, which S73 already showed is grouping-blind
controls.can_fail_because: head_a == head_b, or root_a != root_b (which would mean the groupings were not equivalent in state and the test is void)

controls.name: C_reorder_detected
controls.must_fire_because: swapping two epochs leaves the chain head unchanged -- order would not be committed

controls.name: C_dropped_epoch_detected
controls.must_fire_because: dropping an epoch leaves the chain head unchanged

controls.name: C_split_epoch_detected
controls.must_fire_because: splitting one epoch in two leaves the head unchanged -- a prover could inflate its epoch count for free

controls.name: C_delta_content_bound
controls.must_fire_because: substituting one atom inside a delta, at identical size and identical roots, leaves the head unchanged -- the chain would bind shape, not content (S65)
controls.can_fail_because: the recomputed head equals the honest head

controls.name: C_replayed_epoch_rejected
controls.must_fire_because: an epoch's (root, delta) pair verifies at a different position -- epochs would be transplantable
controls.can_fail_because: verify_chain returns True on the transplanted sequence

controls.name: C_chain_alone_cannot_catch_a_forged_delta
controls.must_fire_because: the chain alone rejects a root its declared delta does not produce -- then it would subsume S73 and this boundary claim is wrong. Also fails if the fold does not reproduce the honest root, which would make the comparison vacuous
controls.can_fail_because: chain_ok reads false, or folded != honest3 (broken fold, control void), or folded == the lied root

falsifier: Exhibit two epoch SEQUENCES that differ in grouping, order, count or delta content and share a chain head. Or show a sequence the chain rejects that is in fact honest.
